name: ftp-mcp-server
title: FTP and SFTP MCP Server
description: Connect an MCP client to an FTP, FTPS, or SFTP server, or run a backup, sync, or compare job.

output.title: MCP response output
output.description: Standby MCP results are returned on /mcp. Automation jobs write a summary, and compare or sync details, to the dataset. Backup and sync files go in the key-value store.
